device.comment: The screen this game is drawn for and judged at: the portrait phone art/world/bible.md and art/interface/bible.md rule against, 540x960 CSS pixels. width and height are the only fields read. They set the viewport every camera clamps against, and see.capture and see.sketch draw at them, so a frame comes out at the shape the art is ruled at. No pixel ratio is declared because nothing renders at one: a PNG is these pixels times the page's own device pixel ratio, which a lane browser forces to 1, and see.capture measures that ratio into the sidecar's profile. orientation is derived from width and height.

plugins.comment: Mouse Look captures the pointer the moment play starts and rebinds the keys for a shooter. Nothing here is aimed with a mouse.
